texts.n:k.k7.bridge_connect:cnSo: -아/어서 links a reason or a sequence (do A, then B); it cannot be used with requests, and its tense is shown only at the end.

bridge_plain.concept: The plain (written) style ends statements in -ㄴ다 / -는다 and past statements in -았다 / -었다. These forms are the base for reported speech in the next lessons.

bridge_adnominal.title: Describing nouns
bridge_adnominal.concept: A verb or adjective can describe a noun: -(으)ㄴ for adjectives and past actions, -는 for present actions, -(으)ㄹ for future or planned actions, placed before the noun.

bridge_connect.title: Basic connectors
bridge_connect.concept: Join two clauses with -아/어서 (reason or sequence), -지만 (contrast), -(으)니까 (reason), -(으)면 (if) and -(으)려고 (in order to).

bridge_modal.title: Ability, obligation, permission
bridge_modal.concept: -(으)ㄹ 수 있다/없다 expresses ability or possibility, -아/어야 하다 obligation, and -아/어도 되다 permission.
